does: The SavingThrow() function of stats conditions: takes the current condition context (the top of the Lua state's context stack), adds a new ConditionRoll to the context's HitDesc (its ConditionRolls at +0x50), resolves the spell for the DC (the HitDesc's +0x150, else the context's +0xE0) and rolls the save through unplaced::RollSavingThrow; returns 1.0 or 0.0 with the verdict.

evidence.says: reads the context frame at the top of the stack (+0x88 array, +0x94 count of its second argument); frame +0x0 is the source entity, +0x10 the target used when none is given, +0x68 the HitDesc; calls eoc::ConditionRolls::AddNew and unplaced::RollSavingThrow

the chains of Sacred Flame's save, Hold Person's save and repeat save and See Invisibility's save all pass it at bg3_dx11.exe@25605617+0x116BC47; one call per Sacred Flame cast in a probe, from bg3_dx11.exe@25605617+0x10EDD97
